title: The Effect of Ablation Therapy on Barrett's Esophagus
brief_summary: To assess the effect of ablative therapy (Photodynamic Therapy or Radiofrequency ablation ) on Barrett's Esophagus
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who have had or qualify for ablation therapy for treatment of their barrett's esophagus with high grade dysplasia or early esophageal adenocarcinoma
* Ability to provide informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status 3 or 4
* Inability to tolerate endoscopic procedures
* Pregnancy: Females of child-bearing age will be screened with pregnancy test.
study_population: Patients who have had or qualify for ablation therapy for treatment of their barrett's esophagus
